Maya — adding a few clarifying notes ahead of the workshop so procurement has concrete scenarios to evaluate.

Scenario A — Pilot -> Scale (recommended path)
- Start: Compact tier + feature bundle A (streaming, structured output, basic caching).
- Transition: After 90 days or 200k tokens/day sustained, lift to Throughput tier.
- Financials: One-time migration fee waived for first-year pilots; step-up pricing delta ~ +22% on baseline token rate. Burst credits: 200% monthly buffer for first quarter, then revert to standard.
- Downgrade: Prorated credit applied to next billing cycle based on committed tokens; features that require Dedicated (private routing) will be paused but data retained for 60 days.

Scenario B — Cost-first steady-state
- Start: Compact + quantized model profile with aggressive caching; optional add-on for private VPC when needed.
- Financials: Lower base token price, pay-as-you-go for private deployment and SLA add-ons. Downgrade is immediate with pro rata credit; exports of audit logs available on request.

Ask for procurement: please confirm which scenario aligns to your Q3 objectives and share any hard constraints on SLA or on-prem requirements so we can tailor numbers.

I can lead the workshop and walk the MAP draft; Aditya will bring the billing/proration examples. Happy to run a quick 15-minute pre-call if you want to review the choiceboard before the full session.

- Lauren Bishop
Director, Solutions and Pricing
Redwood Inference
